Package index

Emulation

Fit a dynamic Bayesian emulator to simulator runs and predict the spatiotemporal output at new inputs. Exact (MCMC-free) posterior updates.

prepare_data()
Prepare PDE emulator training and testing data from CSV files
emulator_learn()
Fit an FFBS-based dynamic emulator
emulator_predict()
Predict simulator output from a fitted emulator
print(<spDBL_emulator>) summary(<spDBL_emulator>) predict(<spDBL_emulator>)
Print, summarize and predict from a fitted emulator

Calibration

Infer mechanistic parameters from field data without new PDE solves. Requires an emulator fitted with covariance = "sigma2R"; the sampler uses RStan (suggested package).

calibration_prepare()
Prepare a fitted emulator for PDE-free calibration
print(<spDBL_calibration_input>) predict(<spDBL_calibration_input>)
Print and predict from a prepared calibration object
calibration_validate()
Validate offline calibration predictions against held-out simulations
calibration_fit()
Fit modular calibration conditional on emulator posterior draws
calibration_predict()
Recover fields at the calibrated observation times and locations
summary(<spDBL_calibration>)
Summarize modular calibration samples
plot(<spDBL_calibration>)
Plot calibrated mechanistic parameter samples

dt_calibration

Forward filtering and backward sampling

Advanced. The matrix-variate dynamic linear model kernels behind emulator_learn(). Three covariance models: inverse-Wishart (no suffix), scalar variance times a fixed correlation (_sigma2R), and identity (_I).

FF()
Forward Filter for the MNIW dynamic linear model
FF_sigma2R()
Forward Filter for the scalar-sigma-squared-times-R model
FF_I()
Forward Filter with identity right-covariance
FF_1step_R_sigma2R()
Single forward filter step (scalar right-covariance, sigma-squared times R)
FF_1step_R_I()
Single forward filter step (identity right-covariance)
BS()
Backward sampler for the Forward Filter Backward Sampler (FFBS)
FFBS()
Forward Filter Backward Sampler (MNIW model)
FFBS_sigma2R()
Forward Filter Backward Sampler (scalar sigma-squared-times-R model)
FFBS_I()
Forward Filter Backward Sampler (identity right-covariance)
FFBS_sampling()
Draw posterior samples from FFBS output (MNIW model)
FFBS_sampling_sigma2R()
Draw posterior samples from FFBS output (scalar sigma-squared-times-R model)
FFBS_sampling_I()
Draw posterior samples from FFBS output (identity right-covariance)
FFBS_predict_exact()
Exact posterior predictive mean using FFBS smoothed states (MNIW model)
FFBS_predict_MC()
Monte Carlo prediction using FFBS output (MNIW model)

One-step log posterior predictive density (scalar sigma-squared-times-R model)
lppd_id_1t()
One-step log posterior predictive density (identity right-covariance model)
compute_analytical_waic()
Analytical WAIC for an MNIW multivariate regression posterior
compute_sample_waic()
WAIC from paired coefficient and covariance draws

Legacy calibration helpers

Building blocks from the research code of Banerjee et al. (2025), where calibration solved the PDE at every MCMC iteration. No other package function calls them. New work should use calibration_prepare() and calibration_fit().

update_y_eta()
Update the likelihood of observations given PDE parameters (Monte Carlo)
update_y_eta_one()
Update the likelihood of observations given PDE parameters (single sample)
update_muSigma_eta_one()
Compute posterior predictive mean and covariance without sampling (single sample)
sample_y_eta_one()
Draw predictive samples from a precomputed mean and covariance
cal_Bt_bt()
Update the posterior mean and covariance of the discrepancy field
scale_uniform()
Scale a vector to the unit interval via a uniform transformation
scale_back_uniform()
Invert a uniform scaling transformation
expit()
Logistic (expit) function
cal_jacobian_logit_uniform()
Log absolute Jacobian of the logit-uniform transformation
